method.throughput: closed-loop publish -> basic_get(auto_ack) cycle, batch<=256 msgs in flight (queue depth bound for the 1024-entry capacity of the reference-free broker), 5% warm-up, count auto-calibrated per cell/payload
method.latency: publish -> get -> ack round trip, one msg in flight
method.floor: connection open+close (all cells) and bare TCP/UDS connect+close with no AMQP at all
method.single_connection: one connection per broker at a time, sequential, same process, same pika

endpoint.via: host publish: no userspace proxy hop

baseline_note: captured explicitly by compare.py --update-baseline; regenerate only after a human review of the run
